title: sslcode-panel.json
description: Describes an SSL Code panel. Put it at the root of a public GitHub repository with the topic sslcode-panel.

name.description: The panel's name, shown on its pill and in the search.

description.description: One line on what the panel shows or does.

icon.description: Path in the repository to a square SVG or PNG icon.

page.description: Path in the repository to the panel's page: one self-contained HTML file (5 MB at most) that speaks MCP Apps. It can load nothing from other files.

sites.description: Every site the page talks to or loads from, as https:// or wss:// origins. Anything else is blocked. Leave it out for a panel that uses no network.

tools.description: An MCP server (stdio) that gives the page and the agent tools. It runs on the user's machine with the user's rights.

npx.description: An npm package pinned to an exact version, run with npx.

command.description: A command run in the panel's own folder, such as node. Its code lives in this repository.

needs.description: Other software the panel needs on the user's machine. Until it is found, the panel shows Needs <name> with a Get link and does nothing else.

app.description: A Mac app, found by its bundle id.

command.description: A command found on the PATH.
